name: Gerard Tiller
summary: At the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard Tiller works under the warm sun and longs for spring water. He offers a shiny red apple to any traveler who brings him a skin of it.

sections.title: A Thirsty Farmhand
sections.body: Gerard Tiller works the grounds outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards, south of Goldshire. The vineyard is known for its grapes, and keeping the harvest going takes hard labor. The chores leave Gerard thirsty, so he welcomes travelers who bring him a skin of fresh spring water. In return, he gives them shiny red apples gathered from local orchards.

faq.answer: Gerard Tiller works as a human farmhand outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can I find Gerard Tiller?
faq.answer: Look outside the large wooden barn at the Maclure Vineyards, south of Goldshire and east of the Stonefield Farm.
Gerard trades a Shiny Red Apple for a skin of Refreshing Spring Water.

faq.q: Does Gerard get involved in the Maclure and Stonefield feud?
faq.answer: No. Gerard works at the Maclure Vineyards and focuses on his chores and getting water, rather than the rivalry between the Maclures and Stonefields.

angles.text: Gerard trades fresh apples for plain spring water, making him a source of fruit for travelers who want simple ingredients.
